measurement_notes: Medians and ranges describe three Oracle RPCD windows per side or two shared-consumer windows per side; deltas subtract independently summarized medians.
RPCD CPU uses process-clock own CPU, not coarse proc tick/tree CPU. Required helper children are outside this own-CPU column.

Concurrent c4 CPU window includes80 warmups and denominator is successful+80. Mean/p99 exclude warmups; c4 throughput uses successful divided by group uptime snapshot interval including setup/warmup, with0.01s export resolution.
Command reaped CPU comes only from getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) counters in shared-child-cpu.json; coarse subject_cpu_us_per_op tick values are not used.
Netifd CPU uses process-clock own CPU. No same-precision reaped child counter exists in these inputs; no-spawn proof/other gates belong to the main report.
